title: GTA 6: Things To Do Before Chapter 2
description: The end of Chapter 1 in GTA 6 features a point of no return. Discover everything you will lose access to and what you should complete first.

content:
## Essential Things To Do Before Reaching Chapter 2 in GTA 6

As players dive deeper into the world of *Grand Theft Auto VI*, gaming media outlet GameRant has highlighted a crucial milestone that players need to be aware of: **the end of Chapter 1 features a definitive point of no return**. Crossing this threshold means players will lose access to certain content, missions, or areas available only in the opening phase of the game.

For completionists and players who want to experience everything the game has to offer without missing out, careful planning during Chapter 1 is vital. Here is a breakdown of what you should keep in mind before stepping into Chapter 2.

### Understanding the Chapter 1 Point of No Return

In massive open-world titles, narrative shifts often alter the game world dramatically. Based on recent reports, Chapter 1 serves as the foundational setup for the game's broader narrative. Triggering the final sequence of the first chapter will transition players into Chapter 2, but this progression comes at the cost of locking out specific early-game opportunities.

### What You Should Complete First

To ensure you don't miss out on vital experiences or missable content, it is strongly recommended to take a step back from the main storyline once you approach the end of Chapter 1. Consider focusing on the following:

*   **Clear All Side Content**: Make sure all available stranger missions, side activities, and introductory tasks in Chapter 1 are fully completed.
*   **Gather Collectibles**: If any collectibles or unique items are tied exclusively to the early map areas, secure them now.
*   **Explore Early-Game Locations**: Certain interiors or localized areas might change or become inaccessible as the narrative shifts into the second chapter.

### Editor's Take

Point of no return mechanics are a classic storytelling tool used by Rockstar Games to heighten narrative tension, but they can easily catch unprepared players off guard. Taking the time to wrap up Chapter 1 thoroughly ensures a smoother transition into the sprawling content of Chapter 2. Keep multiple saves if possible, and check your quest log twice before moving forward!
